# i inserts before the cursor; <Esc> steps back one
text:  ‸
keys:  ihello<Esc>
want:  hell‸o

# the owner's first example: arrows, <Del> and <Insert> in normal mode
text:  ‸
keys:  ihello<Esc><Left><Left><Del><Insert>LL<Esc>
want:  heL‸Llo
reg:   " c l

# a appends after the cursor
text:  ‸ac
keys:  ab<Esc>
want:  a‸bc

# A appends at the end of the line
text:  ‸foo
keys:  A bar<Esc>
want:  foo ba‸r

# I inserts before the first non-blank
text:  ␠␠fo‸o
keys:  I-<Esc>
want:  ␠␠‸-foo

# <Left> in insert mode stays in insert mode
text:  ‸ab
keys:  A<Left>X
want:  aX‸b
mode:  insert
